content: fetch vs axios: fetch is native (zero bundle cost), axios adds ~11.7kB gzipped plus a dependency but provides automatic JSON parsing, uniform error-throwing on non-2xx, and interceptors. For a small 2-endpoint REST client (GET /products, GET /products/:id), native fetch wrapped in a small typed helper (parse JSON, throw on !response.ok) is sufficient and keeps bundle lean; reach for axios only if interceptor/retry features are needed later.
